name: How to choose materials that balance quality and cost?

mainEntity.name: How to choose materials that balance quality and cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for mid-range options that offer durability and style, such as builder-grade fixtures with efficient performance. Consider energy-saving products that qualify for rebates and incentives.
